cases.sentence: А Моисей был очень кротким , самым ___ на земле.
cases.explain: «кротким человеком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

cases.explain: «облачном столбе» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

cases.sentence: Не дай ей стать похожей на мертворожденного младенца, у которого уже истлела половина тела, когда он вышел из ___.
cases.explain: «материнского чрева» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
